title: Disposal of Seized Articles Subject to Decay

content.scenario: The Director-General seizes some perishable goods during an investigation, which are subject to speedy decay.
content.outcome: The Director-General or such other officer may dispose of the seized articles in the prescribed manner, as per sub-section (4) of section 22, to prevent decay or loss.

user_queries: What happens to seized articles that are subject to decay?
How are seized articles disposed of?
What is the procedure for disposing of seized articles subject to decay?
